newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African stock market closing report.
newsitem.headline: S.African stock market closing report.

text.p: South African shares swiftly overcame early nervousness on Wednesday to race ahead and post solid gains in heavy trade as positive sentiment continued to sweep through the market, dealers said.
A renewed fall in the bullion price to below $343 -- just a day after a mini-rally sparked hopes of an upturn -- gave dealers a fright early on and most shares opened down.

But as the rand roared ahead to break through the psychologically important 4.50 level against the U.S. dollar, South African shares quickly won back all their losses and headed firmly for positive territory.
The all-share index added 38.1 points to 6,804.1 as the industrials index adds 25.2 points to 8,133.4.
Volumes were a huge 996 million rands worth of shares. "It was a tremendous day. There is good buying from overseas and good buying locally," one dealer said.
The futures market also made healthy gains as the all-share March contract rose to 6,286/98 from 6,206 and the industrial contract stood at 7,931/33 from 7,854.
The gold contract fared less well and was at 953/60 from 973.
